create_timeseries_instance: create a TimeSeries instance from numpy arrays of times and data with optional signal mapping
validate_timeseries_inputs: validate TimeSeries construction rejects empty arrays non-1D times length mismatches and non-monotonic times
save_and_load_timeseries: save a TimeSeries to an npz file and load it back recovering identical times data and signal mapping
interpolate_timeseries_values: interpolate TimeSeries data at scalar or array time points using linear cubic quadratic or zero_order_hold methods
resample_timeseries: resample a TimeSeries onto a finer or coarser time grid by specifying new times or a target timestep
create_control_names_timeseries: create a TimeSeries from actuator control data with auto-discovered or explicit actuator names mapped to SignalType.MjCtrl
create_sensor_names_timeseries: create a TimeSeries from sensor data with auto-discovered or explicit sensor names mapped to SignalType.MjSensor
create_state_names_timeseries: create a TimeSeries from state data using name and SignalType tuples for qpos or qvel signals
create_custom_map_timeseries: create a TimeSeries with custom signal definitions using name strings and dimension tuples with SignalType.CustomObs
compute_all_state_mappings: compute qpos qvel and actuator state index mappings for a MuJoCo model verifying full coverage without duplicates
